outcome.outcome: Critical supply chains gain mapped failure points and pre-positioned fallbacks, so a shock to one node stops propagating into cascading loss of industrial capability.
outcome.rationale: Their framing is fragility plus absent backup; the unlock is that a single-node failure stops being systemic.

ai_types.rationale: Redundancy is technically simple and economically unrewarded; the binding constraint is who pays to hold slack nobody is billed for.
Network cascade modelling to locate single points of failure works now and is not what is missing.

measurability.rationale: Single-source dependence and inventory depth are measurable inputs, but resilience itself only reveals under a shock that has not happened.

outcome.outcome: Airborne and surface transmission can be interrupted by the built environment and by materials, decoupling outbreak control from voluntary behavioural compliance.
outcome.rationale: Every listed capability acts on the physical environment rather than on behaviour, which is where the leverage sits.

ai_types.rationale: Antimicrobial surfaces, textiles and better PPE are materials and geometry design problems with well-specified objectives.
Surface and coating screening is exactly the bench-scale formulation loop self-driving labs already run in adjacent domains.

measurability.rationale: Filtration efficiency, air changes per hour and chamber-trial transmission reduction are direct, standardised quantities.

outcome.outcome: Novel pathogens are detected while transmission is still containable, and their source can be attributed after the fact.
outcome.rationale: Their description names both halves, detection latency and attribution, and both are needed for intervention to be possible.

ai_types.rationale: Metagenomic anomaly detection over sequencing and wastewater streams is deployed today; the science is ahead of the deployment.
Sample sharing and cross-border reporting agreements gate how much of the working detection capability actually gets used.

measurability.rationale: Time from emergence to first detection and estimated case count at detection are both reconstructable for past outbreaks.

outcome.outcome: Countermeasure development outpaces pathogen evolution, so resistance emergence stops setting the shelf life of the antimicrobial arsenal.
outcome.rationale: Their framing is a race; the unlock is winning it, which means development time falling below evolution time.

ai_types.rationale: Generative antibody and antiviral design against a named target works now; seven of their listed capabilities are discovery-side.
Closing the design-test loop for candidate validation is the near-term extension of working self-driving chemistry.

measurability.rationale: Time from pathogen sequence to validated candidate, and resistance prevalence over time, are both tracked surveillance quantities.

outcome.outcome: Synthesis screening becomes universal and hard to evade, closing the cheapest route from a dangerous sequence to physical material.
outcome.rationale: Their description states the requirement itself: implementation must be coordinated and universal to reduce risk at all.

ai_types.rationale: Their own text makes universality the binding condition; partial screening simply relocates demand to unscreened providers.
Sequence-level hazard screening and watermarking are working techniques; coverage, not capability, is the shortfall.

measurability.rationale: Share of global synthesis capacity under screening is measurable; misuse prevented is not, since the counterfactual attacks are unobserved.

notes: Two of five take an institutional primary despite every gap being framed technically. Their capability lists are consistently discovery-side while the stated blocker is deployment or coverage.
